revenueModel.text: Consumers purchase sports and outdoor products through direct-to-consumer e-commerce and retail stores, and through wholesale partners including sporting goods retailers and specialty stores.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate revenue from the sale of our products through direct-to-consumer and wholesale channels: • Direct-to-Consumer includes sales of our brands' products through (i) owned e-commerce websites and (ii) owned retail stores, which include elevated brand stores that drive consumer engagement and factory outlet stores which serve as a liquidation channel.
